answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity with matching bonds locked on two independent chains: a fraud proof on either chain slashes both deposits at once. Like an echo bouncing between two canyon walls, the penalty reverberates across chains, so the delta between one chain's cost and the attack's gain stays negative. A comet of fakes cannot split its capital: every fake must fund two bonds, doubling the entry price, while one honest agent pays once and trades freely.
